summary: Regression retest after the Admin report access fixes. Backend: GET /api/finance/summary and GET /api/gps/active now use Depends(REPORTS). Owner and admin get 200, barteam gets 403, unauthenticated gets 401. 7/7 pytest passed. Frontend (desktop 1920): ran every category-tabs-dropdown option and every Reports subtab. Owner had 34 selections and Admin 27. Every subtab landed on its exact URL. There were 0 pageerrors, 0 'user is not defined' errors, and 0 API responses >=400 across the whole run. Admin /finance shows the KPI cards, the expenses form and the ledger with no 403. The Admin dashboard made no /api/gps/active 403 calls over 5s. Bare /reports shows the subtab as 'Penjualan' (value /reports?view=sales). All 3 issues from iteration_48 are fixed.

issues: On Dashboard > Laporan, category-tabs-dropdown ('Laporan') stretches across most of the bar width even though it has a max-w class. Cosmetic only, low priority.

action_items: Optional: limit the width of category-tabs-dropdown on desktop.
critical_code_review_comments: The REPORTS role dependency (owner+admin) now matches the App.js REPORT_ACCESS guard for finance and gps. Consider one shared role matrix to prevent future drift.
Customers.jsx also calls /gps/active when the promo dialog opens; it is fine for owner/admin but would 403 silently (.catch) for other roles if they can reach it.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (61 dropdown selections, finance, gps and label checks)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Login via page.request POST /api/auth/identify then /api/auth/login (cookie). Owner baa/130994, Admin dummy_admin/100002, Barteam dummy_barteam/100003. Start routes for the dropdown loop: /, /rider-stock, /pos-dashboard, /inventory, /user-info (owner) or /settings (admin).
rca of the issue: The iteration_48 issues came from backend SUPER (owner-only) dependencies conflicting with the widened frontend guard, plus the subtab select value '/reports' matching no option. Both are fixed: REPORTS dependency on the backend, and value mapping in Layout.jsx.
